section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 25, Gånsta-Boglösa
section.notes: Main route from Gånsta/Gånstagården to Boglösa, with optional alternatives via Bredsandslingan and a spur to Hemsta/Boglösa hällristningsområde.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 25 GPX as primary geometry.
Reverse raw GPX for the written Gånsta-to-Boglösa direction.
Preserve three segments; they are continuous at segment joins.
Do not import Bredsandslingan or Hemsta spur geometry into the main stage.
qa: Computed length 9.611 km is close to official 10 km.
Gånsta start matches Etapp 24 end; Boglösa end should match Etapp 26 start.

checks: All rows have source keys present in sources.
GPX was downloaded from Naturkartan and parsed by segment.
Object coordinates for Brännskogen, Stora Grindtorp, Gånsta parking and bus stop were extracted from Naturkartan direction links.
Bredsandslingan and Hemsta spur leakage are separated from the main stage.
Iteration 2 quality pass: source keys, declared counts, supported import types, decision coverage and mapdata drawability revalidated across all numbered Upplandsleden etapper.
Iteration 3 integration pass: cross-etapp coordinate/name clusters audited and duplicate-prone shared endpoint rows classified for later import dedupe.
Iteration 4 deepening pass: object-level sources, coordinates and import/pending boundaries rechecked.
Iteration 5 final pass: source references, decision buckets, counts, dedupe readiness and mapdata drawability revalidated.
limitations: Hemsta rest-area coordinate is route-snapped pending exact object page.
Boglösa endpoint parking needs exact object coordinate.
Full agent reports for this stage may add details.
Boglösa endpoint parking remains access metadata/pending rather than a normal facility.

iterationLog.summary: Compiled first-pass Etapp 25 from Naturkartan route/object pages, Bredsandslingan and Hemsta spur pages, and Upplandsstiftelsen Bronze Age trip context.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary import rows use Naturkartan route/object pages. Optional loop/spur features are pending or suppressed so they do not pollute the main Gånsta-Boglösa stage.
nextIterationNeeds: Compare all five agent reports when available.
Find exact Hemsta rest-area and Boglösa endpoint parking coordinates.
Decide how separate files should handle slinga 25:1 and avstickare 25:2.
Verify if Stora Grindtorp parking/rest table should be a separate normal row or remain access metadata.

iterationLog.summary: Integration/dedupe pass for Etapp 25: compared rows against adjacent and same-coordinate etapper to flag shared endpoints, repeated access metadata and route/loop leakage for later import consolidation.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Rows remain section-scoped for traceability; actual app import should use the separate dedupe registry generated in this pass to collapse canonical shared facilities.
